findings.source: required source list does not enforce complete local runtime dependency closure
findings.consequence: an omitted event publisher or calendar can change without source seal rejection
findings.remedy: require every runtime dependency in manifest or compute local dependency closure before verifying each hash

findings.resolution: Required direct entry files added; every statically required relative runtime dependency must appear in sealed sourceHashes and each source hash is verified.
findings.verification: Independent temporary fixture: omitted publisher rejected; missing transitive runtime rejected; sealed closure accepted.
